summary: Frontend-only test of IncassoSheet (incasso/pagamento with automatic open-invoice sheet, bank contra-account) in Prima nota, desktop 1920 and mobile 390. All requested flows pass: new-incasso-btn/new-pagamento-btn open the sheet; choosing IN/PG in reg-causale-select of a NEW registration closes the dialog and opens the sheet (other causali like AM stay in the dialog); editing an existing IN entry opens the normal dialog and picking PG there does not open the sheet. Party search works, open invoices are sorted by oldest due date (2/2026 20/11, 3/2026 30/11, 1/2026 10/12); clicking a row toggles it and fills the residual; the amount can be edited (partial 50 accepted; typing in the input does not toggle the row); select-all and deselect-all work; inc-totale shows count, total and the Dare/Avere hint; the bank defaults to 06.01.001 Banca c/c and 06.01.002 can be chosen; the save button is disabled when total is 0. Save IN created the entry Dare 06.01.001 172 / Avere 05.01.001 172 with the client party, causale IN, description 'Incasso fatt. 2/2026, 3/2026 TEST_T39 Cliente UI'. Invoice 2/2026 was closed and 3/2026 dropped to 72 'parziale'; payments were created with coge_entry_id; the entry shows in the prima nota list. PG: entry Dare 13.02.001 (supplier party) / Avere 06.01.001 574.93, custom date 2026-11-09 kept, passive invoice closed, and reopening the sheet for that supplier shows inc-no-aperte. Overpaying (500 on a 122 residual) is rejected by the backend with a clear toast and the sheet stays open. Mobile: sheet usable and save works with the second bank, but the table scrolls sideways.

issues: The invoice table is wider than its container (scrollWidth 438 vs 338), so the 'Da pagare' input (inc-importo-*) is cut off at the right edge. The user has to scroll sideways to edit a partial amount. Consider a stacked card layout or hiding the Totale column on mobile.
The TOTALE and RESIDUO column headers run together on mobile.
inc-data-input uses the browser's native date picker, not the shadcn calendar (same as other pages; low priority).

The frontend does not stop an amount above the residual or a negative amount. The input max/min attributes are not enforced, so the total can show e.g. 500 before the backend rejects it. Clamp the value in setImp.

action_items: Optional: make the IncassoSheet table responsive on mobile so the Da pagare input is visible without scrolling sideways
Optional: clamp inc-importo values to 0..residuo on the client side
critical_code_review_comments: IncassoSheet.save uses par.fornitori/par.clienti without a null check. If /contabilita/parametri fails (the error is swallowed by catch(() => {})), save throws a TypeError. The banche list is also empty, so the bank select is blank without any message.
The success toast counts all selected rows (scelte.length), including rows whose amount was set to 0 and so were not included in saldaconto.
The banche filter uses par.banca.slice(0,5) (e.g. '06.01'). This works for the default chart of accounts but is fragile if the bank account code has another length.
seed_data_creation: Used existing TEST_T39 UI Srl company (eecbaf6c-...) from t39_ui_setup.py; created 3 entries (IN x2, PG x1) with payments. Cleaned at end via `t39_ui_setup.py clean eecbaf6c-c681-4cf2-9a8d-bf20dbe60b58` (needs REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported). No TEST_T39 companies remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via page.request.post /api/auth/login then set localStorage fe_company_id. Sheet testids: incasso-sheet, inc-party-search-input/-option-<party_id>, inc-row-<invoice_id>, inc-importo-<invoice_id>, inc-select-all, inc-totale, inc-banca-select, inc-data-input, inc-descrizione-input, inc-save-btn, inc-cancel-btn, inc-no-aperte, inc-empty. The container clock is 2026-11-10. To recreate data, run `export $(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL frontend/.env); python backend/tests/t39_ui_setup.py setup`.
